properties.displayName: UAV S13 - Satellite Link C2 Hijacking (Regular Beaconing over Whitelisted Endpoint)
properties.description: UAVDatalinkConn_CL의 SATCOM 링크에서 Watchlist(C2_Whitelisted_GCS_List)상 허가된 원격 엔드포인트로 향하는 정상적으로 보이는 세션임에도, 세션 내 연속 이벤트 간격(IntervalSec)의 변동계수(StdevInterval/AvgInterval)가 매우 낮아 기계적으로 규칙적인 비컨(beacon) 패턴을 보이는 정황 탐지 — Turla(G0010) 스타일의 정상 위성 ISP 세션에 편승한 C2 비컨/태스킹 트래픽 은닉 기법. MITRE Enterprise ATT&CK: T1090.002 Proxy: External Proxy
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 2h;
let minSamples = 8;
let jitterThreshold = 0.05;
let WhitelistedGCS = _GetWatchlist('C2_Whitelisted_GCS_List') | project GCS_IP;
UAVDatalinkConn_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where LinkType == 'SATCOM'
| where RemoteEndpoint in (WhitelistedGCS)
| partition by SessionId (
    sort by TimeGenerated asc
    | extend PrevTime = prev(TimeGenerated)
    | extend IntervalSec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, PrevTime)
)
| where isnotnull(IntervalSec) and IntervalSec > 0
| summarize
    SampleCount = count(),
    AvgInterval = avg(IntervalSec),
    StdevInterval = stdev(IntervalSec),
    UAVId = any(UAVId),
    RemoteEndpoint = any(RemoteEndpoint),
    TotalBytesSent = sum(BytesSent),
    TotalBytesReceived = sum(BytesReceived)
    by SessionId
| where SampleCount >= minSamples and AvgInterval > 0
| extend CoeffVariation = StdevInterval / AvgInterval
| where CoeffVariation < jitterThreshold
| extend TriggerReason = strcat('SATCOM_C2_규칙비컨_탐지_', RemoteEndpoint, '_주기', tostring(round(AvgInterval,1)), 's_CV', tostring(round(CoeffVariation,3)))
| extend Severity = 'High'
| project SessionId, UAVId, RemoteEndpoint, SampleCount, AvgInterval, StdevInterval, CoeffVariation, TotalBytesSent, TotalBytesReceived, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by CoeffVariation asc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S13 - Satellite Link C2 Hijacking (Regular Beaconing over Whitelisted Endpoint) - {{UAVId}}
